info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Salesforce User Interface API
Records
Salesforce Experience Cloud Get Record UI

params.name: recordIds
params.description: One or more record IDs (comma-separated for multiple records, up to 200)

params.name: childRelationships
params.description: Comma-separated list of child relationship names to include

params.name: formFactor
params.description: Form factor for the layout

params.name: layoutTypes
params.description: Comma-separated layout types to return

params.name: modes
params.description: Comma-separated modes for the layout

params.name: optionalFields
params.description: Comma-separated list of optional fields to include

items.docs: Returns layout information, field data, and object metadata for one or more records. Provides everything needed to render a record detail page including layout sections, field values, and display properties.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Get a Record

params.name: recordId
params.description: The 18-character Salesforce record ID

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of field API names to return

params.name: layoutTypes
params.description: Layout type whose fields to include

params.name: modes
params.description: Layout mode

params.name: optionalFields
params.description: Optional fields to include if accessible

items.docs: Returns field values and metadata for a specific record. Supports requesting specific fields or all fields from a layout. Returns both raw values and display-formatted values.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Update a Record

params.name: recordId
params.description: The 18-character Salesforce record ID

items.docs: Updates the specified record with the provided field values. Returns the updated record representation including the new field values.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Delete a Record

params.name: recordId
params.description: The 18-character Salesforce record ID

items.docs: Deletes the specified record. The record is moved to the Recycle Bin.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Create a Record

items.docs: Creates a new record of the specified sObject type. Returns the created record representation with all field values.

info.name: Layouts
Salesforce Experience Cloud Get Record Layout

params.name: objectApiName
params.description: The API name of the Salesforce object (e.g., Account, Contact)

params.name: formFactor
params.description: Form factor for the layout

params.name: layoutType
params.description: Type of layout to retrieve

params.name: mode
params.description: Mode for the layout

params.name: recordTypeId
params.description: Record type ID for the layout

items.docs: Returns layout metadata for the specified object type including sections, fields, and their display properties. Used to render record forms dynamically.

info.name: Object Info
Salesforce Experience Cloud Get Object Info

params.name: objectApiName
params.description: The API name of the Salesforce object (e.g., Account, Contact)

items.docs: Returns metadata about the specified object including fields, record types, child relationships, and theme information. Provides the information needed for metadata-driven UI construction.

info.name: List Views
Salesforce Experience Cloud Get List View Data

params.name: listViewId
params.description: The ID of the list view

params.name: fields
params.description: Additional fields to include in list view records

params.name: optionalFields
params.description: Optional fields to include if accessible

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of records per page

params.name: pageToken
params.description: Token for the next page of records

params.name: sortBy
params.description: Field API name to sort by

items.docs: Returns the records and metadata for a specific list view including columns, sorting, filtering, and the record data. Used to render list views in custom UIs.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Get List Views for Object

params.name: objectApiName
params.description: The API name of the Salesforce object (e.g., Account, Contact)

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of list views per page

params.name: pageToken
params.description: Token for the next page

params.name: q
params.description: Search term to filter list views by name

items.docs: Returns all available list views for the specified object type. Includes list view ID, label, and developer name.

info.name: Actions
Salesforce Experience Cloud Get Record Actions

params.name: recordId
params.description: The 18-character Salesforce record ID

params.name: formFactor
params.description: Form factor for filtering actions

params.name: sections
params.description: Comma-separated list of action sections

items.docs: Returns the actions available for a specific record based on the current user's permissions and the record's state.

info.name: Favorites
Salesforce Experience Cloud Get Favorites

items.docs: Returns the list of favorites for the context user, including records, list views, and other favorited items.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Add a Favorite

items.docs: Adds a record, list view, or other item to the user's favorites.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Remove a Favorite

params.name: favoriteId
params.description: The ID of the favorite to remove

items.docs: Removes the specified item from the user's favorites.
